injuries.name: Zachary Carter
injuries.note: Carter (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injuries.name: Jon Gaines II
injuries.note: Gaines (ankle) is out for Sunday's game versus Washington, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Hunter Long
injuries.note: Long (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injuries.name: Jeremiyah Love
injuries.note: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that he has no update on Love (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve following Sunday's game against the Commanders, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injuries.name: Carson Beck
injuries.note: Beck (back) will not play Sunday against the Commanders, coach Mike LaFleur said Friday, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Amik Robertson
injuries.note: Robertson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Laremy Tunsil
injuries.note: Tunsil (triceps) is progressing well in his recovery but is not expected to return by the end of the 2026 regular season, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.
